issues.description: Top nav wraps to 3 rows on narrow viewport (Home/Symbols/Emoji row clipped above CopyChars logo, Tools/Collections row, then Platforms row). Sitewide header pattern, also affects every other page in this batch.
Same sitewide nav-wraps-to-3-rows issue as instagram page.

In Trending Symbols: two cards labelled 'Ornament' (꧁ and ꧂) and two cards labelled 'Vai' (ꔪ and ꗃ) with identical labels. Instagram/Discord pages distinguish these as 'Open Ornament' / 'Close Ornament'. Inconsistent data per platform.

TikTok page has only 2 category sections (Bio Decorations, Trending Symbols) vs 4 sections on Instagram/Discord. Total ~33 symbols vs 50+ elsewhere. Page is still meaningfully platform-specific (TikTok-flavoured aesthetic chars, dancers, music notes), so not template-thin, just sparser.
Same duplicate-label data issue as desktop ('Ornament'/'Ornament', 'Vai'/'Vai').

Page renders the 404 'Page not found' state instead of a heart symbol detail page. Slug 'heart' is not resolved by the dynamic route, despite hearts being one of the most prominent collections on the site (/hearts exists). Likely missing slug mapping or symbol-data record. Recent SEO PR added per-page canonicals -- a 404 here means the canonical anchor for 'heart' as a single-symbol entity does not exist either.
Same 404 as desktop. Mobile additionally shows the sitewide nav wrapping to 3 rows.

Page renders 404 'Page not found'. Slug 'star' is not resolved by /symbol/[slug] even though stars are an entire site collection (/stars) and the related-symbols block on /symbol/checkmark links to 'Black Star' and 'White Star'. Missing canonical slug for the bare 'star' entity.
Same sitewide header wraps-to-3-rows issue. Page content itself is well laid out vertically with no horizontal scroll.
